'''Doug Harvilla There Can Be Only One''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Douglas Harvilla|Doug Harvilla]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds89.htm There Can Be Only One], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319181608/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds89.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
